name: Hungry
overview: Scripture reveals that true satisfaction comes not only from physical nourishment but from seeking the Lord, as the meek are promised to eat and be satisfied (Psalms 22:26). God honors those who show mercy by feeding the hungry, including even one's enemies, reflecting a heart aligned with His will (Proverbs 14:31; Proverbs 25:21). Generosity toward the poor brings blessing and light to the giver, illustrating the spiritual significance of meeting physical needs (Proverbs 22:9; Isaiah 58:10). Ultimately, Jesus teaches that life is sustained not by bread alone but by every word from God, pointing believers to hunger for His truth above all (Matthew 4:4).
